canonicalGate.requiredInterpretation: This audit does not open or rewrite the Gate. Any START/G4/G6 stage split must first be adopted by a canonical successor and its validators.

threatModelAndNonNegotiables.rule: Auth owns subject-to-person binding; People owns person, employment, legal-employer and organization truth. A consumer cannot synthesize, choose-first, or query another owner's database.
Every protected decision binds tenant, actor, subject, employment, role, scope and requested operation at the current policy-enforcement point; stale or mismatched evidence denies.
Missing owner, transport, receipt, freshness, stream binding, optional capability prerequisite or migration reservation denies the affected operation without fallback.
Production service identities must not retain migration credentials, Flyway authority or schema-changing privileges. Runtime inspection must prove current identity and privilege surface.
A signed receipt alone is insufficient: source revision, inspection epoch, lease, revocation and point-of-use freshness must be bound; expired or replaced authority drains or denies.

A disabled or uninstalled optional capability must be absent from admission and produce zero owner/provider calls. Enabling it without its typed dependency must fail only that capability before external calls.

stageBoundaryDecision.finding: The existing runtime-only wiring v2 correctly describes a production-grade end state, but treating all P2-A/P2-B/P2-C/P3/P4 work as a prerequisite for domain module authoring over-scopes START and conflates G3, G4 and G6.
stageBoundaryDecision.securityPosition: The stage split changes timing, not security semantics. Owner/source/PEP/current freshness, fail-closed and optional no-call remain mandatory at every stage where the capability is exercised.
START: Merge or otherwise freeze one immutable current common-source checkpoint after latest dwp-dev integration.
Provide compile-time owner-neutral identity/authority ports, native owner readers/adapters and fail-closed test doubles to every module; no direct cross-owner database read or fallback.

Freeze exact 8-service/13-stream topology and capability dependency contracts; preserve disabled optional no-call tests. Physical supplemental streams and production credentials are not required for authoring.
Publish collision-free migration successor reservations and prove them against latest upstream high-water marks.
Synchronize five clean module worktree pairs and issue scoped authoring-environment receipts. Sequential host admission is allowed.
Make optional capability admission a machine-readable shared contract with cross-module no-call negatives.
G4: Wire actual authenticated owner transport and current PEP adapters for the feature under integration acceptance.
Register startup guards in relevant service applications and prove enabled supplemental stream schema/role/pool/bootstrap receipts.
Provide Control inspection/publication sufficient for integration, including current-source and race-negative evidence.
Run multi-service native integration, owner-unavailable, stale-receipt, wrong-tenant and privilege-drift tests.
G6: Activate durable multi-resource publication/current ledgers, authenticated workload transport, HSM-backed signing/key rotation/revocation and continuous lease renewal/drain/offline fencing.
Distribute production credentials safely and prove all eight service identities lack migration datasource, migration secrets, Flyway and schema-changing privilege.
Complete customer adoption, production capacity, observability, backup/restore and disaster-recovery evidence.
stageBoundaryDecision.canonicalCaveat: Current canonical material still places broader runtime wiring under G3. Until an approved successor reclassifies the slices and all validators consume it, the effective result remains NO_GO.
